what: Jack Henry provides the core software that small and mid-sized American banks and credit unions run on: the systems that hold accounts, process transactions and connect to payment networks.
customers: Community banks and credit unions across the United States, on long-term processing contracts.
money: account processing systems for banks and credit unions
card processing, bill pay and real-time payments
digital banking, lending and fraud products
moat: Core banking contracts run five to seven years and a conversion is the riskiest project a small bank ever undertakes, so renewal rates are close to total.
risks: Community banks keep merging, which slowly reduces the number of customers
23 times earnings for a business growing revenue in the high single digits
Almost no cash on the balance sheet, though debt is also minimal at $78M
opportunities: A 19.8% net margin and $717M of free cash flow on $2.6B of revenue
Revenue grew from $1.9B to $2.5B in four years, almost entirely recurring
Real-time payments and digital banking sell into banks already paying for the core system
watch: Core contract renewals and growth in the payments segment.
